# GFM specification examples

Test data only. `spec.txt` is never imported by `src/`; `tests/unit/spec-gfm.test.ts` reads it at test time.

- File: `spec.txt` (GitHub Flavored Markdown Spec, version 0.29, dated 2019-04-06 in its header)
- Source URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/github/cmark-gfm/master/test/spec.txt
- Fetched: 2026-10-05 (UTC). The most recent upstream commit touching `test/spec.txt` at that time was `828322d1ee4facdab56f0d3edccb13e9af90dcd2` (2023-03-25, "Update expected output").
- SHA-256: `7d8e5814befec287ac116786d81ff14e0adc9b13295b4494649e995408fd871c`
- Size: 216,680 bytes
- License: CC BY-SA 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/), as stated in the header of the file. Approved for download by the user on 2026-10-05.

The file has 672 examples: 648 core examples, and extension examples marked in the fence line (`example table` 8, `example strikethrough` 2, `example autolink` 11, `example tagfilter` 1). The two task list examples are marked `example disabled`.
